verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no auto top-up rule between accounts and no low-balance alert feature. One-off and batch transfers, generic event webhooks, and agent balance reads are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a recurring automated cash-management capability. These earn no credit under the partial-credit rules.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
